subject: Workplace Skills
title: Negotiating Beyond Salary
description: A quick, practical guide to Negotiating Beyond Salary.

hook.text: The company said salary was firm. She negotiated a signing bonus, extra vacation.

buildup.text: Salary is one piece of compensation. Benefits, flexibility, equity, title, and development budgets are all negotiable.

discovery.text: Companies often have less flexibility on salary but more on other perks. Expanding the negotiation pie creates wins.

twist.text: Non-salary items can be worth more over time. Remote flexibility saves commute costs. Learning budgets build career.

climax.text: Rank what matters most to you. If salary is capped, negotiate the next item on your list. Always have alternatives.

punchline.text: Salary fixed? Negotiate the rest. The total package matters.

quiz.question: Why is it valuable to negotiate beyond just salary?
options: Non-salary items are always worth more than salary
Companies often have more flexibility on perks, and the total package can exceed base salary gains
Employers respect candidates who ask for many things
